name: bsc-mainnet
notes: BSC mainnet. No mainnet deployment exists yet and none is implied by this file: startBlock is null and the section 14 gates are unmet; BSC mainnet is the first deployment target under ADR 034, and the customer launch sequence is ADR 040's. NETWORK IDENTITY, verified 2026-09-18 with scripts/check_chain_record.ts run twice, once against each of the two public read-only endpoints https://bsc-dataseed.bnbchain.org and https://bsc-rpc.publicnode.com, as ADR 037 did for the USDT record; both runs exited zero and agreed on every value. eth_chainId 56 on both. Block 0 hash 0x0d21840abff46b96c84b2ac9e10e4f5cdaeb5693cb665db62a2f3b02d2d57b5b, identical on both. MULTICALL3 at the canonical 0xca11bde05977b3631167028862be2a173976ca11, taken from the Multicall3 project's own deployments list (the source url above; its chain 56 entry is named "BNB Smart Chain" and points at https://bscscan.com/address/0xcA11bde05977b3631167028862bE2a173976CA11#code) and then proved against the chain rather than trusted: 3,808 bytes of code with keccak256 0xd5c15df687b16f2ff992fc8d767b4216323184a2bbc6ee2f9c398c318e770891 on both endpoints, getBlockNumber() inside the head window on both, and aggregate3([getBlockNumber(), getChainId()]) answering a block number inside the same window and chain id 56 on both. Rule CH4 requires these two fields once a mainnet manifest exists; they are filled now, before the manifest, because section 1.7 of docs/runbooks/mainnet-launch.md places the check in the prerequisites and because without a Multicall3 address the round page issues roughly 42 RPC requests per block epoch. The VRF coordinator, the key hash and every feed proxy remain deployment inputs recorded in the plan and the manifest, not here; config/deployments/56/mainnet.plan.json carries the chain 56 values verified on the same day. Both endpoints above are non-archive: bsc-dataseed.bnbchain.org serves state for roughly the last 128 blocks and bsc-rpc.publicnode.com refuses any historical block tag outright, which is the pruning ADR 040 accepts and the reason SPEC section 10.1's partial-history notice is the whole mitigation for entry history.
